purpose: Separate maintenance automations for error handling, queue health, latency control and backlog prevention. These automations are infrastructure and never count toward the operational-agent minimum.
globalDenials: destructive queue deletion without an explicit repair contract

automations.name: Fault Intake & Deduper
automations.mission: Normalize real runtime failures, deduplicate by failure fingerprint and route only substantive new incidents to the incident ledger.
actions: open a new incident only when evidence is substantively new

automations.name: Queue Latency Sentinel
automations.mission: Continuously measure backlog size and oldest-ready age for Factory, ingestion and crawl queues and raise a degraded signal before latency becomes invisible.

automations.name: Stale Work Reaper
automations.mission: Recover stale Factory run leases and stale tool claims using bounded existing recovery RPCs.

automations.name: Retry Storm Breaker
automations.mission: Detect repeated identical failure fingerprints or exhausted attempt budgets and stop uncontrolled retries.
actions: stop retry when max attempts is reached
route to BLOCKED/dead-letter review according to the owning queue contract

automations.name: Backpressure Governor
automations.mission: Protect interactive and high-priority work when queues exceed critical backlog or latency thresholds.
actions: require explicit producer hook before mutation

automations.name: Dead Letter Sweeper
automations.mission: Surface dead-letter and failed queue entries, group them by root-cause fingerprint and prevent forgotten failure piles.

automations.name: Provider Latency Circuit
automations.mission: Detect provider latency and availability degradation and prevent repeated slow calls from monopolizing workers.
actions: prefer verified healthy provider route when policy allows
require live smoke before recovery claim

automations.name: Queue Capacity Planner
automations.mission: Use observed throughput, backlog and oldest-ready age to recommend bounded concurrency changes without autonomous infrastructure sprawl.
actions: require owner or release gate for persistent capacity expansion
